texts.text:
For 15 years, we helped build
YouTube from inside Google.
But what stayed with us were the Creators who brought it to life.
People who picked up a camera, told stories and made a living.
And we saw what it takes.

Just one person
showing up every day.
But too little was built for them.
For years, we built the platform.

Now we're building for the Creators
who bring it to life.

We're here to help every Creator, wherever they are,
spark a successful livelihood.
